blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The P305.12 million Grand Lotto 6/55 jackpot is still unwon, with no bettor guessing the correct winning number combination for the Oct. 26 draw, said the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) on Monday. Aside from the Grand Lotto jackpot, no bettor also won P15 million Megalotto 6/45 jackpot on Monday’s draw. READ: Lotto results for Oct. 26, 2026 According to the PCSO results provided, the Grand Lotto 6/55 draw produced the winning combination 27-38-44-51-20-47, with a jackpot prize of ₱305.12 million.
